title: Three Years and One Short Tool
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：presentation　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 presentation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the craftsman ① gave the presentation that no apprentice in the workshop would have recorded, and he said the giving was the whole of the year. The ② presentation, meaning the show itself and not the tool, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a presentation, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ presentation in that workshop had the same short tool beside it, and the ④ presentation at the far bench, meaning the order they kept for the children to finish and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A presentation, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the craftsman said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the presentation was the whole of the matter, meaning the effort and not the show. The ⑥ presentation, meaning the effort and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; presentation, he said, is either something you give or the only word that means both a show and an effort. He said the effort is the part they remember.

By 1995 the ⑦ presentation had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short tool. The ⑧ presentation of the whole thing, the craftsman wrote in August, was one workshop and three years of recording; presentation, he said, is either the order at the far bench or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ presentation I remember is the show recorded in the ledger, which closed in 1997 and is still recorded as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ presentation, my mother said in 1999, is the only show that improves by being recorded; every presentation, she said, is an effort that has agreed to look like a show. She said the effort was the honest half.

presentation 意为“展示；报告”，指最远那张案台的留给孩子们赶完的那一桩，是唯一有人谢过两次的。

presentation 意为“展示；报告”，我记得的是工料簿里记载过的那一场，1997 年出师了，至今仍被说成工坊里最安静的一场。
